---
title: "ColorModel"
---
<!-- DO NOT EDIT! This file was auto-generated by crates/build/dl_types_builder/src/codegen/docs/website.rs -->

Specified what color components are present in an [`archetypes.Image`](https://dalaran.dev/docs/reference/types/archetypes/image).

This combined with [`datatypes.ChannelDatatype`](https://dalaran.dev/docs/reference/types/datatypes/channel_datatype) determines the pixel format of an image.

## Variants
#### `L` = 1
Grayscale luminance intencity/brightness/value, sometimes called `Y`

#### `RGB` = 2
Red, Green, Blue

#### `RGBA` = 3
Red, Green, Blue, Alpha

#### `BGR` = 4
Blue, Green, Red

#### `BGRA` = 5
Blue, Green, Red, Alpha


## Arrow datatype
```
UInt8
```
